text:
auditor_rachel: Morning team — for SOC2 spot-check we need a small bundle proving RBAC change approvals + KMS grant lifecycle (CreateGrant/RetireGrant/RevokeGrant) for 2025-04-03 14:10-14:40 UTC. Deliverables: logs, grant snapshots, approval artifact, and reproducible export steps. Who owns?

ben: I got this. Will pull KMS admin events + grant APIs, STS AssumeRole traces, and the ticket approval PDF. filing ticket SEC-6230.

evidence-bot: Ticket SEC-6230 created, assignee: ben.

anika: Splunk savedsearch name: "soc2_kms_grants_2025_04_03_v1". Query I'll run:
```
index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=CreateGrant OR eventName=RetireGrant OR eventName=RevokeGrant OR eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) earliest=1765069800 latest=1765071600 | table _time,eventName,userIdentity.arn,requestParameters.keyId,requestParameters.grantId,eventID,sourceIPAddress
```

ben: I'll also run: `aws kms list-grants --key-id <key-id> --query 'Grants[*].{GrantId:GrantId,GranteePrincipal:GranteePrincipal,Operations:GranteePrincipal}' > grants_snapshot.json` and `aws kms describe-key --key-id <key-id> > key_describe.json`.

auditor_rachel: include grant_history diff if policy/grants changed. we want the before/after grant IDs.

anika: will include `git diff` of infra commits used to change key policy (commit range) as `kms_policy_diff.txt` and a small `grant_lifecycle.md` tying events to ticket IDs.

ben: redaction plan: redact external IPs, keep ARNs, provide `redaction_map.csv` with salted hashes. We'll avoid sharing tokens.

compliance-tera: control mapping: one-pager mapping artifacts to SOC2 CC6 (access), CC9 (logging) and a short rationale. auditors prefer csv.

ben: packaging steps: 1) export ndjson from Splunk (job id included), 2) collect aws CLI snapshots, 3) ticket PDF + screenshot, 4) create tarball, `sha256sum bundle.tgz > bundle.sha256`, 5) sign manifest with GPG (key 0xB0B1F00D), 6) upload to `s3://redwood-evidence/sec-6230/` with SSE-KMS and capture s3 put CloudTrail event.

anika: savedsearch job id: 772345001. I'll attach `savedsearch_export.json`.

ben: presign URL created and sent to auditor_rachel off-channel. manifest sha256: d4f7e6c2a1b9c3d8e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d

auditor_rachel: checksum matches. please include the exact CLI commands used in `export_recipe.txt` so we can reproduce. thanks.

compliance-tera: retention note: evidence held 365 days under legal hold. closing unless auditor requests more.
